$comment: Shared test vectors for Rules DSL v1 (docs/adr/0005-hyperliquid-trading-agent.md). Used by worker/test/trading/*.test.ts and the dashboard. canonical = keys sorted, no whitespace, UTF-8; sha256 = hex(sha256(canonical)); describe = lines of the English rendering. invalid[].layer 'schema' = parse errors independent of env; 'limits' = needs `context`. errors = the exact set of codes (sorted, unique) expected.

valid.name: adr example: HYPE dip buyer
describe: When: price change over 1 day is at or below -3%
Do: Buy 10 USDC of HYPE as an immediate-or-cancel limit order at the market price, inside the price band

valid.name: all trigger and order kinds, two pairs, non-ASCII name
describe: Rule set: Zażółć DCA + take profit
When: every 1 week (first run when the rules are activated)
Do: Buy 12.25 USDC of HYPE as a limit order 0.5% below the market price, cancelled after 4 hours
When: position P&L is at or above +12.5% (vs average cost of fills under this rule set; never when flat)
Do: Sell 50% of the HYPE position as an immediate-or-cancel limit order at the market price, inside the price band
When: position P&L is at or below -8% (vs average cost of fills under this rule set; never when flat)
Do: Sell 100% of the HYPE position as a limit order at the market price, cancelled after 15 minutes
When: price is at or below 0.123456 USDC
Do: Buy 10.5 USDC of PURR as an immediate-or-cancel limit order at the market price, inside the price band
When: price change over 4 hours is at or above +5.25%
Do: Sell 25.5% of the PURR position as a limit order 10% above the market price, cancelled after 1 day
